occupancy_events_source_reference.name: occupancy_events_source_reference
occupancy_events_source_reference.value: ("parking_occupancy_events"."source" <> 'hardware' or "parking_occupancy_events"."device_id" is not null) and ("parking_occupancy_events"."source" <> 'video' or "parking_occupancy_events"."video_job_id" is not null)

parking_spaces_booking_minutes.name: parking_spaces_booking_minutes
parking_spaces_booking_minutes.value: "parking_spaces"."min_booking_minutes" between 15 and 43200 and ("parking_spaces"."max_booking_minutes" is null or "parking_spaces"."max_booking_minutes" between "parking_spaces"."min_booking_minutes" and 43200)

parking_spaces_dimensions.name: parking_spaces_dimensions
parking_spaces_dimensions.value: ("parking_spaces"."max_height_cm" is null or "parking_spaces"."max_height_cm" between 100 and 600) and ("parking_spaces"."max_length_cm" is null or "parking_spaces"."max_length_cm" between 150 and 2000) and ("parking_spaces"."max_width_cm" is null or "parking_spaces"."max_width_cm" between 80 and 400)
